OUR EDITORIAL STANDARDS

Useful information.
Clearly explained.

How Wishly Guide plans, researches, writes, reviews and updates its product explainers and practical tutorials.

Last updated: 7 November 2026

Our purpose

Wishly Guide publishes practical information about personal wish websites, creative ideas for meaningful occasions and guidance for using Wishly. Articles should answer a real reader question, explain the steps clearly and help readers make an informed decision.

Who creates the content

Wishly Guide is an independent information hub associated with Wishly. The project is created by RA Fahim, the solo founder and developer behind Wishly. Product-specific instructions are based on the available product interface and project documentation.

Originality and usefulness

We aim to publish original explanations, examples and practical checklists rather than copying content from other websites. When a topic overlaps with a main Wishly product page, the guide should add useful context, examples or step-by-step help instead of repeating the same text.

Product accuracy

Wishly features can vary by template and may change over time. Tutorials should say when an interaction is template-specific and should not promise a feature that is not available in the selected design. Readers should check the current editor and template before publishing.

Updates and corrections

When product behaviour changes or a factual error is identified, the relevant page should be reviewed and updated. Material revisions should be reflected in the page’s updated date and sitemap. Readers can report a correction through the Visit Wishly ↗.

Advertising and editorial independence

Display advertising may appear on eligible content pages when the site is approved and configured. Advertising must remain visually distinct from editorial content. Ads do not determine the subject, conclusions or wording of an article, and no page asks readers to click or interact with ads.

Scope and reader wellbeing

Wishly Guide publishes general informational articles about relationships, communication, emotional support, friendship, family and creative ways to mark meaningful moments. The publication does not provide therapy, diagnosis, emergency response or legal advice. Readers should seek qualified local support for issues that require professional help.

Articles should avoid pressure, manipulation, coercion and assumptions about another person’s feelings. Advice is a starting point, not a universal rule. Readers are encouraged to respect consent, privacy, boundaries and individual circumstances.

Search and content standards

Search phrases help us understand what readers want to learn, but they do not determine the value of an article. We prioritise clear answers, original explanations, practical examples, accurate attribution and useful links over repetitive keyword placement or thin pages.
